name: Blotato
description: Blotato lets agents draft, schedule, and publish posts to the social accounts that the user connects in Blotato. Each user signs in to their own Blotato account through the browser.

prompts.text: Draft a LinkedIn post from this blog article.
Schedule this post for Tuesday at 9:00 on my X account.
What posts are scheduled for this week?

apps.name: Blotato
apps.description: Post drafting, scheduling, and publishing, over Blotato's MCP server with browser sign-in.
